name: In Your Face: Judgment Day

date.source: The fed's own broadcast dateline, dated Thanksgiving Day 1998; posted to Usenet in fourteen parts on 28 November 1998.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Chicago Championship Tournament
matches.how: The fed's own second newsletter and the tournament's own later rounds credit Vars with the win and advancement, though the broadcast's own play-by-play shows Vars hurt on a botched piledriver and Shards pinning him for the three count over the referee's protests; Vars then attacked Shards after being carried out on a stretcher.
matches.note: A discrepancy in the fed's own record: recorded here as the newsletter and the tournament's later bracket state it (Vars advancing to face Eddie Deegan in the semifinal), not as the blow-by-blow commentary shows it.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Chicago Championship Tournament
matches.how: Outcast by Society pinned Marcus Taylor with his finisher, The Downfall, an inverted corkscrew suplex into a 3/4 bulldog headlock.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Chicago Championship Tournament (Hour One main event)
matches.how: The Pink Passion had Deegan caught in the Pink Dreams submission hold, but Deegan reached the ropes and rolled Passion up for the pin.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Chicago Championship Tournament
matches.how: Tucker hit Holloway with the Chronic Jumble Jaw superkick twice in a row, pinning him after Holloway kicked out of a Tornado DDT.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Cook County Championship Tournament
matches.how: Commentator Buck Martinez interfered on both men's behalf, accidentally knocking out Carter with a chair shot meant for Diversity; Diversity then pinned a recovering Carter.
matches.note: Carter, furious at being struck, chased and brawled with Martinez at ringside and in the ring after the match, requiring security to separate them.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Cook County Championship Tournament
matches.how: Grayson rolled up Bergin for the pin after both men had kicked out of finishing moves (a tornado DDT and a spinebuster) earlier in the match.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Cook County Championship Tournament
matches.how: Anderson rolled up Parker for the pin after a back-and-forth finish in which both men traded near-falls off finishing moves.

matches.stipulation: First round, CWC Cook County Championship Tournament (Hour Two kick-off)
matches.how: Putrid pinned Garza with his finisher, the Devil's Tower Drop (a running inverted piledriver), after Garza dropped him on his neck with a moonsault but wasted time before covering.
Vars turned a Deegan DDT attempt into a Northern Lights Suplex for the pin, after Deegan had briefly locked in an STF and Vars kicked out of a Tiger Driver '91.

matches.stipulation: Semifinal, CWC Cook County Championship Tournament
matches.how: Grayson pinned Diversity with the X-Treme Kick after both men briefly went down to a double-clothesline spot with no referee to count; commentator Buck Martinez propped Grayson's arm over Diversity for an uncounted near-fall earlier in the match.

matches.stipulation: Semifinal, CWC Cook County Championship Tournament (Hour Three kick-off)
matches.how: Putrid pinned Anderson with the Devil's Tower Drop after Anderson's own manager, Jacque Cartier, twice interfered at ringside during the match.
matches.note: Jacque Cartier knocked Putrid's hand off the ropes to break an escape attempt and was later blamed by the announcers for a foot appearing on the ropes during a near-fall; the match nonetheless ended clean, with Putrid's finisher.

matches.how: Tucker pinned Outcast by Society with the Chronic Jumble Jaw after reversing an attempted Downfall into an inverted DDT.
matches.note: Commentator Buck Martinez interfered on Outcast's behalf, striking Tucker with a grill attachment, but Tucker recovered to win.

matches.how: Putrid climbed the ladder and retrieved the vacant Cook County Championship belt to win the match and become the fed's first-ever Cook County Champion.
matches.note: A brawl involving both wrestlers spilled outside the ring throughout the match; commentator Buck Martinez was pulled into a side feud with a rival named "Tiny" Tim Thomas, who interfered on Grayson's behalf before Martinez knocked him out with a dropkick that toppled the ladder onto him.

matches.how: Tucker locked in a figure-four leglock and Vars submitted, after Outcast by Society ran in and clipped Vars' knee with a steel chair.
matches.note: Tucker became the fed's first-ever Chicago Heavyweight Champion. Immediately before the match, Antawn Carter chokeslammed both members of a musical act, the Backstreet Boys, after they and Buck Martinez had brawled during the group's in-ring performance.

notes: The fed's own first pay-per-view: two eight-man single-elimination tournaments crowning the CWC's first Chicago Heavyweight and Cook County Champions. A backstage angle in Hour Two, in which Tony Shards was found beaten and bleeding in his own locker room by an unknown assailant, is not resolved in any document this collection holds. A musical interlude (the Backstreet Boys) and a running comedic feud between commentator Buck Martinez and a rival named "Tiny" Tim Thomas are not otherwise structured.
